text:
morgan: hit a surprising behavior in py-sdk 0.7.3 async: upstream returns 422 with text/plain 'missing email', SDK tries json.loads -> JSONDecodeError -> raised RedwoodAPIError but it has no http_status or raw_body. can't detect validation vs auth. anyone seen this?

kai: async or sync?

morgan: async. minimal repro:
```py
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=...) as c:
    await c.users.create({'name': 'Z'})  # -> 422 text/plain 'missing email'
```
exception only: `RedwoodAPIError: failed to parse error body` and hasattr(e, 'http_status') is False.

ines: think we added richer metadata for sync last quarter but missed the async path. quick fix: always read resp.read() into raw_bytes, set err.http_status = resp.status, err.raw_bytes = raw, try decode to err.raw_body with resp.charset or utf-8 errors='replace', then attempt json.loads on raw_body when content-type looks like json. on parse fail keep parsed_json=None but still raise err with metadata. also chain the parse exception as __cause__.

kai: agree. typing: update .pyi so RedwoodAPIError has http_status: Optional[int], raw_body: Optional[str], raw_bytes: Optional[bytes], parsed_json: Optional[dict]. add a small helper `RedwoodAPIError.json()` to return parsed_json or raise a clear parsing error.

morgan: tests: unit that fakes aiohttp response content-type text/plain ensures e.http_status == 422 and e.raw_body == 'missing email'. also test binary/gzip preserved in raw_bytes and raw_body None if decode fails. add mypy check.

dev-bot: CI: branch async-exc-meta  build queued (tests + mypy + lint) <https://ci.internal/py-sdk/7890|details>

kai: small backwards compat: some callers used `.body`. keep a deprecated property `body` that returns raw_body and warns. also make __str__ avoid printing huge bodies (truncate to 1024 chars).

ines: ok I'll draft PR, target 0.7.4 patch. pinging @kai for review. leaving a curl to reproduce: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/users -d '{"name":"Z"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"` returns `HTTP/1.1 422` with plain text body on staging.

morgan: thanks all :thumbsup:
